scenario.title: One-slice effective visibility
scenario.assumption: At these core horizons, 1 cm of original local fallout suffices for recognition as a continuous layer. One slice is the sampling scale. Its status as a visibility scale is an assumption.

support.definition: Exact-site Delaunay triangles: longest edge / minimum vertex third-neighbor distance and circumdiameter / median vertex third-neighbor distance both <= spacing factor.
support.interpretation: Geometry-screened interpolation footprint, not a confidence region, deposit boundary, or guarantee of representativeness. Bounds alone do not establish two-sided local support.
